description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+11

- Windows: mini player fix, see-through slider, PC volume/brightness, updater reopens
  - Mini player: when the window got big some other way (dragged to the top of the screen so Windows maximized it, Win+Up, the taskbar), the app still thought it was in the mini player: no controls and clicks did nothing until a restart. It now notices (window events, plus a size check) and ends the mini player where the window is. A Back-to-full-size press made while it is still shrinking now waits instead of being ignored.
  - Mini player: see-through slider on hover (30–100%), remembered.
  - PC volume and brightness: a pill at the top right of the player with a mute button, volume slider (up to 200%) and brightness slider; mouse wheel over the video = volume, Shift + wheel = brightness; Up/Down = volume, M = mute. Brightness dims the picture (it did nothing on PC).
  - Updater: the installer's log showed the update installing, then the relaunch failing ("file not found"): it started anymex.exe, but the installer names the app "AnymeXStremio Beta.exe". The build now takes the name from the installer script.
